options.content:
Agent Runtime

Task health, provisioning, and optional Kubernetes resources.

panels.title: Working tasks
panels.description: Runtime tasks currently working, including tasks waiting for input or authentication. Conditions overlap; replicas reporting the same configured agent are deduplicated.

panels.title: Submitted tasks
panels.description: Runtime tasks submitted but not yet working. A sustained count can indicate provisioning delays or unavailable runtime capacity.

panels.title: Waiting for input
panels.description: Runtime tasks waiting for a person to respond. These tasks can also be included in Working tasks.

panels.title: Waiting for authentication
panels.description: Runtime tasks that need authentication before continuing. These tasks can also be included in Working tasks.

panels.title: Completions pending delivery
panels.description: Completed runtime tasks whose final response has not yet been delivered. A sustained count can indicate a delivery problem.

panels.title: Failures in the last 15 minutes
panels.description: Failed runtime tasks and rejected scheduled launches observed in the last 15 minutes. This rolling window is independent of the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Age of last successful fleet snapshot
panels.description: Seconds since the newest successful runtime health snapshot in the selected period. The age keeps growing after a failed scrape; no sample means no successful snapshot is available in that period.

panels.title: Oldest task heartbeat
panels.description: Age in seconds of the oldest heartbeat among runtime tasks. A fresh heartbeat shows orchestration liveness, not proof that model or tool work is progressing.

panels.title: Oldest undelivered completion
panels.description: Age in seconds of the oldest runtime completion still awaiting delivery. Investigate delivery errors if this continues rising.

panels.title: Attention by agent and backend
panels.description: Nonzero runtime task conditions by configured agent and backend. Replicas are deduplicated; conditions overlap and must not be added to estimate unique tasks.

panels.title: Runs reaching running / second
panels.description: Agent Runtime runs that reached a running backend per second. Provisioning failures before that point are excluded.

panels.title: Terminal outcomes / second
panels.description: Includes provisioning failures; do not divide by successful starts to manufacture a failure percentage.

panels.title: Successful provisioning duration (P95)
panels.description: 95th-percentile time to provision runs that successfully reached running, including scheduling and image pulls. Failed provisioning does not contribute a successful duration observation.

panels.title: Completion delivery outcomes
panels.description: Final-response delivery attempts per second by interface and outcome. Retries can produce multiple attempts for one completion.

panels.title: Runtime boundary refusals
panels.description: Runtime crossings refused or held per second, grouped by reason. These are boundary events, not a count of unique conversations or all policy rule checks.

panels.title: Steering messages / second
panels.description: Messages delivered into running agent sessions per second, grouped by steering mode.

panels.title: Pending export outcomes
panels.description: Runtime file-export events per second by outcome, including admitted, held, and failed cleanup events. One export can have more than one lifecycle event.

panels.title: Sandbox command outcomes
panels.description: Code sandbox commands per second by outcome. These are command executions, not agent runs or inference calls.

panels.title: Sandbox engine failures
panels.description: Sandbox runtime errors per second by bounded error code. An engine-unreachable error is distinct from an individual command failure.

panels.title: Sandbox runtime state by replica
panels.description: Current sandbox runtime state for each process. The active state is 1; inactive states are 0, and different replicas may report different states.

panels.title: Runtime pods by phase
panels.description: Requires Kubernetes collectors. Cluster capacity is shared with workloads outside the selected namespace.

panels.title: Ready runtime pods
panels.description: Requires Kubernetes collectors. Cluster capacity is shared with workloads outside the selected namespace.

panels.description: Requires Kubernetes collectors. Cluster capacity is shared with workloads outside the selected namespace.

panels.description: Requires Kubernetes collectors. Cluster capacity is shared with workloads outside the selected namespace.

panels.description: Requires Kubernetes collectors. Cluster capacity is shared with workloads outside the selected namespace.
